Keep tags out of rewrite/text; those fields contain spoken words only. Use an empty audioTags array when none are supported by the source.

Also return nextActions: at most 4 one-click fixes, only for a phrase the feedback names as blocked (it does not fit its slot, it re-voices too many words, or its take failed checks).
